name: Quartz
description: Quartz is a static site generator that turns Markdown notes into a fast, linked digital garden website.
notes: Distributed as a repository template, so the v5.0.0 sources are vendored into src/ and their plugins are installed from the pinned commits in quartz.lock.json at image build time. GitHub's latest-release marker still points at v4.0.8 (2023); v5.0.0 (2026-03-14) is the newest tag and the default branch. firstRelease is a best-effort year for Quartz 3 (Hugo-based, 2021-2022). This setup keeps only the content, folder-listing, GFM, link and draft plugins.
